Because that anger comes from the same person who cares deeply, stands up for herself, and never hesitates to stand up for the people she loves. The smile, the craziness, the stubbornness, the temper — all of it is just you. I wouldn't trade any part of it for a calmer, easier friend.

Exhibit CLittle things

Proof that you were thinking of me.

They might look like nothing to anyone else. To me, every one of them is a whole memory in disguise.

Every time I see them, they remind me of you — and somewhere behind each one is a memory of you thinking about me. That's what makes them matter. All of it, together, adds up to the last one on this shelf.

I miss you.

We've met once in the last seven or eight months. Between everything going on with my health, a lot of normal things had to wait — nights out included.

But none of that made the friendship disappear. You're still the person I think of the second something happens — "I need to tell Scimmia this." And whenever you have a problem, I'm here. I won't always have the perfect fix, but I'll listen, I'll stand beside you, and I'll show up.
